## Open

### T-373 — Add a regression test for a rejecting step with a not-started dependent

> _2026-10-18 · core/blong-chain · open_

F-260 is fixed by creating the promise entry in PromiseManager.reject when a step failed before its
dependent started, but the party suite is the only thing that exercises it: the dependent
(matrixRelease) never runs in a green run, so the defect can return unnoticed. The difficulty is
that the executor creates the entry at the first then, so a test needs a dependent that is queued
and never started while its dependency rejects. Find a way to reproduce that in index.test.ts
(perhaps by a step whose function is never invoked), and assert execute() rejects within a second
instead of hanging. An unhandled rejection must not escape either: the lazily created entry carries
a no-op catch for that.
